title: AI-Driven Digital Twin for Predictive Maintenance in Urban Infrastructure: Enhancing Structural Resilience and Sustainability
authors: Dita Diana, Putri, Anggi Angga Mukti
primary_research_topic: AI-Driven Digital Twin for predictive maintenance in urban infrastructure
relevance_to_intellitwin: Provides qualitative background on DT concept and maintenance strategies; low methodological overlap with turbofan prognostics.
notes: Qualitative case study analysis; lacks quantitative datasets algorithmic formulation or statistical UQ.

title: A Survey on AI-Driven Digital Twins in Industry 4.0: Smart Manufacturing and Advanced Robotics
authors: Ziqi Huang, Yang Shen, Jiayi Li, Marcel Fey, Christian Brecher
primary_research_topic: Comprehensive review of AI-driven Digital Twin technologies across Industry 4.0
relevance_to_intellitwin: Foundational taxonomy for AI and Digital Twin integration multi-scale models and data synchronization.
notes: Over 300 papers reviewed; highlights gap in systematically integrating domain-specific prognostic UQ into DTs.

title: A Review of Urban Digital Twins Integration, Challenges, and Future Directions in Smart City Development
primary_research_topic: Urban Digital Twins integration challenges and future directions in smart cities
relevance_to_intellitwin: Contextual reference for Digital Twin data integration architectures and lifecycle platforms.
notes: Bibliometric and thematic review; focused on civil/urban planning rather than industrial degradation or RUL.

title: DIGITAL TWIN AND AI ENABLED PREDICTIVE MAINTENANCE IN BUILDING INDUSTRY
venue: Nanyang Technological University (School of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering)
primary_research_topic: Digital Twin and AI-enabled predictive maintenance for HVAC and chiller systems
relevance_to_intellitwin: Exemplifies comprehensive engineering realization of a cyber-physical Digital Twin for predictive maintenance.
notes: 180-page PhD thesis; focused on chiller fault detection and cooling systems rather than aero-engine RUL or conformal UQ.

title: AI-driven predictive maintenance and optimization of renewable energy systems for enhanced operational efficiency and longevity
authors: Sakiru Folarin Bello, Ifeoluwa Uchechukwu Wada, Olukayode B. Ige, Ernest C. Chianumba, Samod Adetunji Adebayo
venue: International Journal of Science and Research Archive
primary_research_topic: Predictive maintenance and optimization for renewable energy systems (wind/solar)
relevance_to_intellitwin: Demonstrates economic and operational justification for transitioning from reactive to predictive maintenance.
notes: Conceptual and literature survey; provides high-level industry overview without reproducible empirical models.

title: A Predictive Maintenance Approach in Manufacturing Systems via AI-based Early Failure Detection
authors: Ali Hosseinzadeh, F. Frank Chen, Mohammad Shahin, Hamed Bouzary
primary_research_topic: Machine learning and deep learning for early failure detection in manufacturing
relevance_to_intellitwin: Direct empirical comparison of ML algorithms (RF SVM MLP LSTM) on predictive maintenance telemetry.
notes: Focuses on discrete failure classification on synthetic manufacturing data rather than continuous RUL regression or UQ.

title: Evaluating the Impact of Transitioning Maintenance Strategy from Reactive to Proactive in Power Generation Companies: An Empirical Analysis
venue: WSEAS Transactions on Business and Economics
primary_research_topic: Empirical quantification of cost downtime and safety impacts from proactive maintenance
relevance_to_intellitwin: Provides real-world empirical figures on maintenance cost reductions (20%) and breakdown reductions (35%) under proactive strategies.
notes: Business and econometric empirical analysis; does not evaluate prognostic AI algorithms or RUL uncertainty.

title: Evolution of Digital Twin Frameworks in Bridge Management: Review and Future Directions
authors: Vahid Mousavi, Maria Rashidi, Masoud Mohammadi, Bijan Samali
primary_research_topic: Evolution and architectures of Digital Twin frameworks in structural bridge management
relevance_to_intellitwin: Relevant for decision support integration in DT frameworks; notes that decision support is often neglected in DTs.
notes: Scientometric review of 480+ papers; focuses on structural health monitoring and civil infrastructure.

title: Forecasting bridge damage within a predictive Structural Reliability-based DSS
authors: Francesca Brighenti, Mattia Francesco Bado, Francesco Romeo, Daniele Zonta
primary_research_topic: Structural reliability modeling Markov Chain damage forecasting and maintenance DSS
relevance_to_intellitwin: Directly informs the decision support layer (DSS) by modeling how probabilistic degradation forecasts drive maintenance prioritization.
notes: Combines Markov Chains with reliability index; focuses on bridge structural deterioration rather than deep learning RUL.

title: AI-Driven Digital Twins for Smart Urban Infrastructure: A Comparative Survey of Monitoring and Predictive Maintenance Methodologies
authors: Mohammed Hisamuddin, Mohammed Thafazul Hussain, Ruksar Fatima
primary_research_topic: Comparative survey of AI-driven DT methodologies for infrastructure monitoring and PdM
relevance_to_intellitwin: Comprehensive synthesis across sensing DT architecture machine learning RUL and Explainable AI (XAI).
notes: 30-page working paper/preprint; emphasizes need for unified frameworks linking RUL prediction with decision support.

title: AI-Augmented Digital Twin Architecture for Predictive Maintenance in Smart Urban Infrastructure: A Cross-Domain Engineering Framework
authors: A K M Rezown Mahmud, Raida Islam Hriti, Md Mehedi Hasan, Md Nizam Uddin, Arpita Rany Roy
venue: European Journal of Applied Science Engineering and Technology (EJASET)
primary_research_topic: Architectural design of AI-augmented Digital Twins for predictive maintenance
relevance_to_intellitwin: Exemplifies multi-layer DT framework design (perception physical twin computation application).
notes: High-level engineering conceptual framework; lacks experimental benchmark evaluation or uncertainty quantification.

title: A new era for digital twins: progress and industry adoption
authors: S. K. Khairul Hasan, Colin William Crawford
primary_research_topic: Systematic review of core components technologies and cross-industry adoption of DTs
relevance_to_intellitwin: Defines core components of modern Digital Twins (machine learning edge computing visualization bi-directional coupling).
notes: Comprehensive review across manufacturing aerospace healthcare; confirms rarity of calibrated uncertainty in deployed DTs.

title: From Smart Cities to Manufacturing: A Comprehensive Study on Digital Twin Applications and Barrier
authors: Bhargav Prajwal Pathri, Krishna Vamshi Ganduri
venue: IET Digital Twins and Applications (Wiley / IET)
primary_research_topic: Digital Twin applications across smart cities and manufacturing and implementation barriers
relevance_to_intellitwin: Highlights aeronautical structural health monitoring and identifies data integration and scalability barriers in DTs.
notes: Systematic qualitative review; discusses operational barriers to real-time asset synchronization.

title: Research on Remaining Useful Life Prediction of Equipment Based on Digital Twins
authors: Jiaju Wu, Yuanlin Zhou, Xiaodong Wang, Chuan Chen, Yongqi Ma, Chunrui Zhang
primary_research_topic: Digital Twin model and GA-optimized ensemble learning for online RUL prediction on C-MAPSS
relevance_to_intellitwin: HIGH RELEVANCE: Directly pairs Digital Twin architecture with data-driven RUL prediction on NASA C-MAPSS FD001.
notes: Proposes GA-stacking ensemble for point RUL prediction; does not provide prediction intervals uncertainty calibration or maintenance policies.

title: Digital Twin-Driven Communication-Efficient Federated Anomaly Detection for Industrial IoT
authors: Mohammed Ayalew Belay, Adil Rasheed, Pierluigi Salvo Rossi
primary_research_topic: Communication-efficient federated anomaly detection leveraging Digital Twin synthetic data
relevance_to_intellitwin: Demonstrates integration of Digital Twin simulation to generate synthetic training telemetry for distributed ML models.
notes: Targets federated anomaly detection; does not address run-to-failure degradation RUL regression or conformal calibration.
